flows.name: SD growth
flows.rate: AUX("$SD growth rate") * LEVEL("$SD Population") * (1 - LEVEL("$SD Population") / AUX("$SD carrying capacity"))

info.description: The textbook logistic-growth stock and flow: one level (Population) fed by one flow whose rate reads the level itself, r * P * (1 - P/K), so growth slows as the population nears its carrying capacity. Needs the system-dynamics grid (simulation.sd) to integrate -- placing this asset does not set it for you (Run > Run experiment (SD step and method)), because a model may mix this with entities that need no grid at all.
